ZYRON'S ESCAPE (C64, 1987) - full port of the DSC crack image.
Spine: INIT -> 7 MACRO LOADER nodes (LOAD_ORG ZYRON_DISK) -> START GAME.
Every ORG block on the right holds the original code at its original address.
All data lives in the assets at the original addresses too, so the world map
($4000-$99FF, 256 x 90 tiles), charset, sprites, scroll text and panel can be edited
in the asset manager. ZE_WORLD_MAP is a RAW CHARS map
256 x 90

; ZYRON'S ESCAPE - ZE_KEYS ($CC00)  added by the port, not in the original game
; The original RESET WORLD wrote tile $33 back at 39 hard-coded addresses, so the keys
; could not be moved. Now the map is scanned once at boot (KEY_SCAN, called from the
; START block) and every $33 tile found is remembered here. RESET WORLD calls
; KEY_RESTORE, the panel calls KEY_DIGITS. Paint keys anywhere in ZE_WORLD_MAP
; (up to 64 of them) and the game follows.
;
; ZP $2F/$30 is reused as the pointer - the game only uses it inside the key pickup
; ($C51F), which never runs at the same time as these routines.
    jmp KEY_SCAN                 ; $CC00
    jmp KEY_RESTORE              ; $CC03
    jmp KEY_DIGITS               ; $CC06

; --- KEY_SCAN: walk the map $4000-$99FF, record every $33 (one page per row, so
;     row = high byte, column = low byte)
KEY_SCAN:
    lda #$00
    sta KEY_COUNT
    sta $2f
    lda #$40
    sta $30
    ldy #$00
KS_LOOP:
    lda ($2f),y
    cmp #$33
    bne KS_NEXT
    ldx KEY_COUNT
    cpx #$40                     ; table holds 64 keys
    bcs KS_NEXT
    tya
    sta KEY_LO,x
    lda $30
    sta KEY_HI,x
    inc KEY_COUNT
KS_NEXT:
    iny
    bne KS_LOOP
    inc $30
    lda $30
    cmp #$9a                     ; end of map (row 90)
    bne KS_LOOP
    rts

; --- KEY_RESTORE: put every recorded key back and reset the keys-remaining count
KEY_RESTORE:
    ldx KEY_COUNT
    stx $cac0                    ; keys remaining
    beq KR_DONE
KR_LOOP:
    dex
    lda KEY_LO,x
    sta $2f
    lda KEY_HI,x
    sta $30
    ldy #$00
    lda #$33
    sta ($2f),y
    cpx #$00
    bne KR_LOOP
KR_DONE:
    rts

; --- KEY_DIGITS: KEYS REMAINING nn on the panel, screen codes $B0-$B9
KEY_DIGITS:
    lda KEY_COUNT
    jmp hud100033_KEYS           ; HUD field KEYS: two digits at $0668, screen codes $B0-$B9

KEY_COUNT:
    .byte $00
KEY_LO:
    .byte $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00
